hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { log=$(mktemp -t mount-lock.XXXXXX); if bash .github/mount-from-lock.sh --root . >"$log" 2>&1; then grep -E 'layers cache|^mount:lock' "$log"; else echo "WARNING: LAYERS NOT CURRENT. mount:lock failed, so mounts are missing or stale and local checks may pass falsely. Full log: $log"; grep -vE '^ +(current|mounted) ' "$log" | tail -20; fi; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1; bash cat-harness-tools/scripts/session-start-coord-sweep.sh; }
